findings.subject: @atom63/ui-react
findings.summary: The @atom63/ui-react root entry does not tree-shake. One small component costs 36-110 kB gzip, and the size check cannot see it.
findings.evidence: esbuild 0.28.2 one-symbol probes against packages/ui-react/dist/index.js (minified ESM, react external): Kbd 36,509 B gzip, Badge 38,247, Button 38,759, Separator 109,752. Every probe retains all of @atom63/ui-foundation (72.2 kB min), tailwind-merge (27.5 kB), sonner (19.7 kB) and input-otp (9.6 kB); Separator also retains 178.8 kB of @base-ui/react. Causes in dist/index.js (5535 lines, one module): static `import ... from 'sonner'` (:23-24) and `'input-otp'` (:29) evaluated for every consumer, and un-annotated top-level calls that bundlers must keep: React3.createContext at :42, :43, :485, :1262, :1924, :2610, :2760, :2788, :4105, :5023, :5163, :5463, and `getCrossRendererContract("load-more-trigger")` at :3069, which drags in the full cross-renderer contract table. check:ui-react-size (check-ui-react-bundle-size.mjs:117-139) only sums gzip of every dist chunk (97.3/100 kB) and has been raised 13 times since 64 kB (:9-116); check:ui-react-root-deps guards only react-day-picker. Downstream: mdx credits-block 164 kB and widgets ./state 167 kB (r2-architecture-2, -3).
findings.fix: Build per-component modules (tsup/rollup preserveModules, or one entry per component folder re-exported by the root) so an unused component's imports are never evaluated. Mark top-level createContext/forwardRef/memo calls /* @__PURE__ */ (or move getCrossRendererContract lookups inside the component). Replace or add to the total-size budget an import-cost check (size-limit or an esbuild probe like the one above) for representative single imports, e.g. Button <= 8 kB gzip, failing in CI.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx
findings.summary: The 'lightweight' credits-block entry pulls 164 kB gzip.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/README.md:22 calls @atom63/mdx/blocks/credits-block a 'Lightweight credits-only import'. esbuild probe of CreditsBlock from dist/blocks/credits-block-entry.js: 163,987 B gzip (@base-ui/react 185 kB, motion-dom 123 kB, ui-foundation 73 kB, framer-motion 21 kB minified). dist/chunk-DJSENA7Q.js imports Separator and Collapsible from the ui-react root and AnimatePresence/motion from motion/react at module scope.
findings.fix: Fix r2-architecture-1 first, then import motion lazily or swap AnimatePresence for CSS in the credits block. Add an mdx import-cost check for the entries the README calls lightweight, or drop the word.

findings.subject: @atom63/widgets
findings.summary: A helper-only import from @atom63/widgets/state costs 167 kB gzip.
findings.evidence: esbuild probe of getWidgetErrorDescription from packages/widgets/dist/state/index.js: 167,362 B gzip. The ./state module also defines WidgetStateFeedback, which imports Button, Popover*, CopyButton from the @atom63/ui-react root and lucide icons, so the helper retains them. WidgetCard from ./primitives: 111,583 B gzip.
findings.fix: Split the pure resolvers (getWidgetErrorDescription, resolveWidgetFeedbackState, DEFAULT_WIDGET_ERROR_LABELS) into their own module or entry with no component imports; fix r2-architecture-1 for the rest.

findings.subject: @atom63/styles
findings.summary: There is no CSS budget, and the consumer CSS grew 9.7% in two days without any check flagging it.
findings.evidence: Registry smoke consumer (all packages' CSS): 505.75 kB raw / 74.22 kB gzip in CI run 44218177744 (2026-11-18), 555.00 kB / 81.07 kB gzip in sweep-r2/ds-registry-smoke.log (2026-11-20). The only budget is ui-react JS (check-ui-react-bundle-size.mjs:117).
findings.fix: Add a CSS budget check: gzip of the built consumer CSS from the pack smoke (or of @atom63/styles + recipes.css), with a stated limit and the same written-reason rule as the JS budget.

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-foundation
findings.summary: ui-foundation is a single 30.7 kB gzip module with no budget. One contract costs 8.8 kB gzip.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-foundation/dist/index.js: one file, 5239 lines, 30.7 kB gzip. esbuild probe importing only buttonContract: 8,771 B gzip. Retained whole (72 kB minified) through the ui-react root in every probe.
findings.fix: Emit per-contract modules (preserveModules) so one contract does not pull shared tables. Annotate top-level derived values (e.g. copyButtonSizes = copyButtonSizePairs.flatMap at :3726) as pure. Add the package to an import-cost budget.

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-react
findings.summary: react-hook-form is a required peer that the root entry imports eagerly, so every consumer must install it. The install docs leave it out.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/package.json peerDependencies react-hook-form ^7.81.0, no peerDependenciesMeta; dist/index.js:27 `import { FormProvider, Controller, useFormContext, useFormState } from 'react-hook-form'` in the root. packages/ui-react/README.md:16 `pnpm add @atom63/styles@beta @atom63/ui-react@beta`. Works only where the package manager auto-installs peers (npm 7+, pnpm default). With yarn or legacy-peer-deps, any root import fails to resolve.
findings.fix: Move Form to its own subpath (as Calendar moved to ./calendar), mark react-hook-form optional in peerDependenciesMeta, and add react-hook-form to check:ui-react-root-deps' subpathOnlyDependencies. Until then, list it in the README install line.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx
findings.summary: mdx exact-pins @atom63/ui-react as a dependency, not a peer. Upgrading ui-react alone installs a second copy with separate React contexts.
findings.evidence: npm view @atom63/mdx@0.4.0-beta.4 dependencies: '@atom63/ui-react': '0.2.0-beta.13', '@atom63/styles': '0.1.0-beta.9' (0.4.0-beta.3 pinned ui-react 0.2.0-beta.12). Policy chose this (dependency-version-policy.json workspaceDependencyPolicy, 'exact-published-before-stable'). The same policy makes react-hook-form a peer for the shared-instance reason (typeVisibleDependencies), which applies equally to ui-react's theme and environment contexts.
findings.fix: Make @atom63/ui-react (and @atom63/styles) a peerDependency of mdx with a beta range, keep it as a devDependency for the workspace, and add a duplicate-copy assertion to the pack smoke.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx
findings.summary: mdx tiers 13 of 14 entries 'stable' on a 0.x beta package, and the two tier statements contradict each other.
findings.evidence: docs/design-system/package-export-tiers.json:4 defines stable as 'breaking changes need a major version'; :10-23 marks every mdx entry except ./primitives stable. packages/mdx/README.md:13-16 says the package is still beta and a release can still change a Stable entry. The package depends on beta, exact-pinned ui-react (r2-architecture-7), so it cannot keep that promise.

findings.subject: release pipeline and CI
findings.summary: Release beta fails on main whenever the pending changesets produce no diff.
findings.evidence: Runs 44690602481 and 44694908112 (2026-11-20, push to main): job 'Open or update the Version Packages pull request' logs 'nothing to commit, working tree clean' then 'Process completed with exit code 1' at the `git commit` in release-beta.yml (version-pr step). The fix branch claude/release-skip-empty-version-pr has CI in progress (run 44702918802) and is not on main.
findings.fix: Merge the skip-empty fix: after pnpm release:version, exit 0 when `git status --porcelain` is empty, and count only changesets that touch published packages in the detect job.

findings.subject: release pipeline and CI
findings.summary: PR CI depends on the live npm registry and on committed evidence, so a publish fails unrelated PRs.
findings.evidence: ci.yml:151-152 runs check:ds-registry-smoke on every PR. Run 44694328626 (claude/r2-contract-names) failed with ERR_PNPM_FETCH_404 for @atom63/styles-0.1.0-beta.9.tgz minutes after it was published. Run 44218177744 failed with 'Registry consumer smoke evidence is stale' after a publish, before record-evidence committed new evidence.
findings.fix: Run the registry smoke on main/schedule and after publish (record-evidence already does), not as a PR gate; on PRs keep check:ds-pack-smoke, which tests the tarballs built from the PR. If it must stay, retry on 404 and compare evidence against the versions npm currently resolves.

findings.subject: release pipeline and CI
findings.summary: Known web flakes go untracked: the WebKit sign-in story failed again, and there is no flake register, quarantine or retry policy.
findings.evidence: Run 44203452194 (2026-11-17): cross-browser (webkit) FAIL packages/templates/src/pages/sign-in-page/sign-in-page.stories.tsx > Wrong Password. The story's play function (sign-in-page.stories.tsx:40-43) is unchanged since #95. grep for 'flak' in docs, apps, .github and scripts returns nothing; vitest/Playwright retry is set nowhere for web. No lightbox-focus failure appears in the 40 most recent failed CI runs.
findings.fix: Fix the sign-in story's wait (await the error with findByRole('alert') and a longer timeout after the submit settles). Keep a short flake register (test, first seen, runs, owner) in docs/design-system and have CI tag known flakes so a rerun is not the fix.

findings.fix: Add a small script (or extend check-package-correctness) that reads every packages/*/package.json and fails on an @atom63 dependency that points up the order styles/ui-foundation -> ui-react -> mdx/inform/widgets/templates, or on a cycle. Or configure no-restricted-imports per package.

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-react
findings.summary: Consumers who type-check dependencies hit an upstream csstype break that the smoke test pins around.
findings.evidence: scripts/design-system/smoke-registry-ui-react.mjs:45-49 pins csstype 3.2.3 because 3.2.4 breaks motion's MotionStyle (TS2320) for any consumer that type-checks its dependencies; ui-react and widgets/mdx depend on motion ^14.14.0.
findings.fix: Note the workaround (skipLibCheck or a csstype override) in the ui-react README troubleshooting section, and remove both when csstype is fixed.
